findings.mechanism: N+1 query pattern: each order serialization issues a separate SELECT for line items, causing query count to scale with number of orders
findings.remediation: Replace per‑order SELECT with eager loading (e.g., selectinload) or batch fetch line items for all orders in a single query
findings.arithmetic: 50 orders × 1 line‑item SELECT each = 50 queries + 1 order‑list query = 51 total queries per request

prediction.condition: GET /orders for a customer with 50 orders of 3 line items each
